def decode_blob(blob):
    return zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(blob.encode("ascii")))


def has_runtime_tree(path):
    path = Path(path)
    return (path / "agent_ppo" / "workflow" / "train_workflow.py").exists()


def detect_code_dir():
    cwd = Path.cwd().resolve()
    candidates = []
    if cwd.name == "code" and has_runtime_tree(cwd):
        candidates.append(cwd)
    if has_runtime_tree(cwd / "code"):
        candidates.append(cwd / "code")
    if has_runtime_tree(cwd):
        candidates.append(cwd)
    for candidate in candidates:
        return candidate.resolve()
    raise SystemExit("run this script from project root or code/ directory")


def backup_changed_file(target, code_dir, backup_dir):
    if not target.exists():
        return False
    backup_target = backup_dir / target.relative_to(code_dir)
    backup_target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(target, backup_target)
    return True


def write_payload(code_dir):
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    backup_dir = code_dir / f".r8_c7_4_fixed_low_lr_full_backup_{stamp}"
    backed_up = 0
    changed = 0
    for rel, blob in PAYLOAD.items():
        target = code_dir / rel
        data = decode_blob(blob)
        if target.exists() and target.read_bytes() == data:
            continue
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if backup_changed_file(target, code_dir, backup_dir):
            backed_up += 1
        target.write_bytes(data)
        changed += 1
    return backup_dir if backed_up else None, backed_up, changed


def validate_payload(base_dir, skip_dynamic=False):
    mismatches = []
    for rel, expected in EXPECTED_HASHES.items():
        if skip_dynamic and rel in DYNAMIC_FILES:
            continue
        target = base_dir / rel
        if not target.exists():
            mismatches.append((rel, "missing", expected))
            continue
        actual = hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if actual != expected:
            mismatches.append((rel, actual, expected))
    if mismatches:
        for rel, actual, expected in mismatches[:10]:
            print("hash mismatch:", rel, "actual=", actual, "expected=", expected)
        raise SystemExit(f"payload validation failed: {len(mismatches)} mismatches")


def patch_text_regex(text, pattern, replacement, label):
    text, n = re.subn(pattern, replacement, text, count=1, flags=re.S)
    if n != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"failed to patch {label}")
    return text


def enforce_dynamic_config(base_dir):
    changed = []
    conf_path = base_dir / "agent_ppo" / "conf" / "conf.py"
    text = conf_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    original = text
    text = patch_text_regex(
        text,
        r'TRAINING_MATCHUP\s*=\s*_env_choice\("R5_TRAIN_MATCHUP",\s*"[^"]*"\)',
        f'TRAINING_MATCHUP = _env_choice("R5_TRAIN_MATCHUP", "{TRAINING_MATCHUP}")',
        "TRAINING_MATCHUP",
    )
    weights_repl = "\n".join([
        "TRAINING_MATCHUP_WEIGHTS = _env_text(",
        '        "R5_TRAIN_MATCHUP_WEIGHTS",',
        f"        {json.dumps(TRAINING_MATCHUP_WEIGHTS)},",
        "    )",
    ])
    text = patch_text_regex(
        text,
        r'TRAINING_MATCHUP_WEIGHTS\s*=\s*_env_text\(\s*"R5_TRAIN_MATCHUP_WEIGHTS",\s*"[^"]*",\s*\)',
        weights_repl,
        "TRAINING_MATCHUP_WEIGHTS",
    )
    text = patch_text_regex(
        text,
        r'INIT_LEARNING_RATE_START\s*=\s*_env_float\("R8_INIT_LR",\s*os\.environ\.get\("R5_INIT_LR",\s*[^\)]*\)\)',
        'INIT_LEARNING_RATE_START = _env_float("R8_INIT_LR", os.environ.get("R5_INIT_LR", 8e-5))',
        "INIT_LEARNING_RATE_START",
    )
    text = patch_text_regex(
        text,
        r'TARGET_LR\s*=\s*_env_float\("R8_TARGET_LR",\s*os\.environ\.get\("R5_TARGET_LR",\s*[^\)]*\)\)',
        'TARGET_LR = _env_float("R8_TARGET_LR", os.environ.get("R5_TARGET_LR", 8e-5))',
        "TARGET_LR",
    )
    text = patch_text_regex(
        text,
        r'TARGET_STEP\s*=\s*_env_int\("R8_TARGET_STEP",\s*os\.environ\.get\("R5_TARGET_STEP",\s*[^\)]*\)\)',
        'TARGET_STEP = _env_int("R8_TARGET_STEP", os.environ.get("R5_TARGET_STEP", 1))',
        "TARGET_STEP",
    )
    if text != original:
        conf_path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        changed.append(str(conf_path.relative_to(base_dir)))

    for rel in ["agent_ppo/conf/train_env_conf.toml", "agent_diy/conf/train_env_conf.toml"]:
        path = base_dir / rel
        if not path.exists():
            continue
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        original = text
        text = patch_text_regex(text, r'opponent_agent\s*=\s*"[^"]*"', f'opponent_agent = "{TRAIN_OPPONENT}"', f"{rel} opponent_agent")
        text = patch_text_regex(text, r'eval_opponent_type\s*=\s*"[^"]*"', f'eval_opponent_type = "{EVAL_OPPONENT}"', f"{rel} eval_opponent_type")
        if text != original:
            path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
            changed.append(rel)

    kaiwu_path = base_dir / "kaiwu.json"
    kaiwu_text = json.dumps({"model_pool": [int(EVAL_OPPONENT)]}, indent=4) + "\n"
    if (not kaiwu_path.exists()) or kaiwu_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig") != kaiwu_text:
        kaiwu_path.write_text(kaiwu_text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        changed.append("kaiwu.json")
    return changed


def validate_dynamic_config(base_dir):
    conf_text = (base_dir / "agent_ppo/conf/conf.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    checks = [
        f'_env_choice("R5_TRAIN_MATCHUP", "{TRAINING_MATCHUP}")',
        TRAINING_MATCHUP_WEIGHTS,
        'INIT_LEARNING_RATE_START = _env_float("R8_INIT_LR", os.environ.get("R5_INIT_LR", 8e-5))',
        'TARGET_LR = _env_float("R8_TARGET_LR", os.environ.get("R5_TARGET_LR", 8e-5))',
        'TARGET_STEP = _env_int("R8_TARGET_STEP", os.environ.get("R5_TARGET_STEP", 1))',
    ]
    for needle in checks:
        if needle not in conf_text:
            raise SystemExit(f"config validation missing: {needle}")
    workflow_text = (base_dir / "agent_ppo/workflow/train_workflow.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    if "should_report_monitor = is_eval or" not in workflow_text:
        raise SystemExit("c6.3 eval monitor no-throttle fix missing")
    if "build_eval_matchup_monitor_data" not in workflow_text:
        raise SystemExit("eval matchup metric builder missing")
    monitor_text = (base_dir / "agent_ppo/conf/monitor_builder.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    if "eval_matchup" not in monitor_text:
        raise SystemExit("eval matchup monitor group missing")
    for rel in ["agent_ppo/conf/train_env_conf.toml", "agent_diy/conf/train_env_conf.toml"]:
        path = base_dir / rel
        if not path.exists():
            continue
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        if f'opponent_agent = "{TRAIN_OPPONENT}"' not in text:
            raise SystemExit(f"train opponent mismatch in {rel}")
        if f'eval_opponent_type = "{EVAL_OPPONENT}"' not in text:
            raise SystemExit(f"eval opponent mismatch in {rel}")
    kaiwu = json.loads((base_dir / "kaiwu.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    if kaiwu.get("model_pool") != [int(EVAL_OPPONENT)]:
        raise SystemExit("kaiwu.json model_pool mismatch")


def compile_python_files(base_dir):
    count = 0
    for path in sorted(base_dir.rglob("*.py")):
        if "__pycache__" in path.parts or any(part.startswith(".r8_") for part in path.parts):
            continue
        source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        compile(source, str(path), "exec")
        count += 1
    return count


def mirror_to_root(code_dir):
    if code_dir.name != "code":
        return False, code_dir, 0
    root_dir = code_dir.parent
    if not has_runtime_tree(root_dir):
        return False, root_dir, 0
    copied = 0
    for rel in MIRROR_SUBSET:
        src = code_dir / rel
        dst = root_dir / rel
        if not src.exists():
            continue
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if dst.exists() and dst.read_bytes() == src.read_bytes():
            continue
        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
        copied += 1
    validate_payload(root_dir, skip_dynamic=True)
    validate_dynamic_config(root_dir)
    return True, root_dir, copied


def main():
    os.environ["R8_INIT_LR"] = R8_INIT_LR
    os.environ["R8_TARGET_LR"] = R8_TARGET_LR
    os.environ["R8_TARGET_STEP"] = R8_TARGET_STEP
    code_dir = detect_code_dir()
    backup_dir, backed_up, payload_changed = write_payload(code_dir)
    validate_payload(code_dir, skip_dynamic=False)
    dynamic_changed = enforce_dynamic_config(code_dir)
    validate_payload(code_dir, skip_dynamic=True)
    validate_dynamic_config(code_dir)
    py_count = compile_python_files(code_dir)
    mirrored, root_dir, copied = mirror_to_root(code_dir)
    print("R8-c7.4 selfplay fixed low LR full patch applied")
    print("code_dir:", code_dir)
    print("payload_files:", len(PAYLOAD), "payload_changed:", payload_changed)
    print("dynamic_changed:", dynamic_changed if dynamic_changed else "none")
    print("backup:", backup_dir if backup_dir else "not needed", "backed_up:", backed_up)
    print("mirrored_to_root:", mirrored, "root_dir:", root_dir, "copied:", copied)
    print("compiled_python_files:", py_count)
